statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, the following holds. If k = 0, then r = 0 exactly when nums1[i] = nums2[i] for every i with 0 ≤ i < n, and r = -1 otherwise. If k > 0, define P = Σ over i with nums2[i] > nums1[i] of (nums2[i] - nums1[i]) / k and N = Σ over i with nums1[i] > nums2[i] of (nums1[i] - nums2[i]) / k, using exact integer division in the successful case. Then r = P if (for every i with 0 ≤ i < n, nums2[i] - nums1[i] is divisible by k) and (Σ_{i=0}^{n-1} nums1[i] = Σ_{i=0}^{n-1} nums2[i]); otherwise r = -1. In the successful case P = N.
preconditions: Let n = len(nums1). len(nums1) = len(nums2) = n; 2 ≤ n ≤ 10^5; for every i with 0 ≤ i < n, 0 ≤ nums1[i] ≤ 10^9 and 0 ≤ nums2[i] ≤ 10^9; 0 ≤ k ≤ 10^5.

statement: For every input satisfying the preconditions, the function returns a result r; it does not fail, panic, or overflow the 64-bit integer range.
preconditions: Let n = len(nums1). len(nums1) = len(nums2) = n; 2 ≤ n ≤ 10^5; for every i with 0 ≤ i < n, 0 ≤ nums1[i] ≤ 10^9 and 0 ≤ nums2[i] ≤ 10^9; 0 ≤ k ≤ 10^5.

statement: If k > 0, then the function returns a nonnegative result r if and only if both of the following hold: (1) for every i with 0 ≤ i < n, nums2[i] - nums1[i] is divisible by k; (2) Σ_{i=0}^{n-1} nums1[i] = Σ_{i=0}^{n-1} nums2[i]. When either condition fails, it returns -1.
preconditions: Let n = len(nums1). len(nums1) = len(nums2) = n; 2 ≤ n ≤ 10^5; for every i with 0 ≤ i < n, 0 ≤ nums1[i] ≤ 10^9 and 0 ≤ nums2[i] ≤ 10^9; 0 ≤ k ≤ 10^5.
